STRUGGLEBUG.fx: 10% chance to lower each foe's Sp. Atk one stage for 30 s.

TAUNT.d: The user jeers across a narrow cone in front of it at mid range. It deals no damage.

THUNDERWAVE.d: The user sends a slow pulse of weak current at one target at mid range. It deals no damage and stops at the first foe it meets.

VENOSHOCK.d: The user fires a splash of toxic liquid at one target at mid range.
VENOSHOCK.fx: Double damage against a poisoned target.

WILLOWISP.d: A slow blue flame drifts toward one target at mid range, curving to follow it. It deals no damage.

WORKUP.d: The user tenses up in place for 5 s.
WORKUP.fx: Raises the user's Attack and Sp. Atk one stage each for 30 s.

ZENHEADBUTT.d: After a short wind-up, the user lunges at a target up to short range, tracking it, and headbutts it.
ZENHEADBUTT.fx: 30% chance to flinch the target for 5 s.

ASSURANCE.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and strikes once.
ASSURANCE.fx: Double damage if the target took damage from anyone in the last 3 s.

BITE.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and bites it once.
BITE.fx: 30% chance to flinch the target for 5 s.

COVET.d: The user dashes in at short range, strikes once, then backs off to where it started.
COVET.fx: 75% chance to steal a random one of the target's held items (any slot) for the rest of the battle, if the user holds fewer than 5.

CRUNCH.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and bites down once.
CRUNCH.fx: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense one stage for 30 s.

CUT.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes in and makes one wide horizontal slash that hits every foe in front of it within reach.

DOUBLEEDGE.d: After a 0.3 s wind-up the user charges in a straight, locked line at top speed. The first foe it meets takes the hit and the user rebounds.
DOUBLEEDGE.fx: The user takes 33% of the damage dealt as recoil.

DRAGONCLAW.d: The user dashes in and rakes the target three times at contact range, each rake a third of the damage.

ENDEAVOR.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at short range and strikes once.
ENDEAVOR.fx: Cuts the target's HP down to the user's current HP. Does nothing if the target already has equal or less HP.

FIREFANG.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and bites it with flaming fangs.
FIREFANG.fx: 10% chance to flinch the target for 5 s and 10% chance to burn, rolled separately.

FIREPUNCH.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and throws a flaming punch.

FLAIL.d: The user dashes in and thrashes at the target four times at contact range.
FLAIL.fx: Power depends on the user's remaining HP: 20 above 70%, rising to 200 below 5%, split across the four blows.

FLAREBLITZ.d: After a 0.3 s wind-up the user becomes a blue-white fireball and rams in a straight, locked line. The first foe it meets takes the hit and the user rebounds.
FLAREBLITZ.fx: The user takes 33% of the damage dealt as recoil. 10% chance to burn.

FOCUSPUNCH.d: The user focuses without moving for 3 s, then lunges at the target and throws one huge punch.
FOCUSPUNCH.fx: Any damage taken during the 3 s focus cancels the punch.

FOULPLAY.d: The user dashes in, grabs the target and throws it over its shoulder to the far side.
FOULPLAY.fx: Hits harder the higher the target's Attack is compared to the user's (0.5x to 2.5x power). The thrown target is pinned for a moment.

FURYCUTTER.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and slashes once.
FURYCUTTER.fx: Each cast within 5 s of the last doubles its power: 40, 80, then 160, capped at 160. Using another move or whiffing breaks the chain.

FURYSWIPES.d: The user swipes 2 to 5 times, dashing through the target and back for each swipe with a short beat between. Each swipe can graze a second foe beside the target.
FURYSWIPES.fx: 2 or 3 swipes 35% of the time each, 4 or 5 swipes 15% each. Each swipe rolls its own 80% accuracy.

GIGAIMPACT.d: After a 0.4 s wind-up the user rams in a straight, locked line as a purple-white comet. The first foe it meets takes the hit and heavy knockback.
GIGAIMPACT.fx: After it rams into a foe, the user is rooted and can't act for 6 s.

GYROBALL.d: The user spins into a steel ball and dashes straight through the target and out the far side, hitting every foe on the line once.
GYROBALL.fx: Power is 25 x the target's Speed / the user's Speed, from 1 to 150. The slower the user, the harder it hits.

HEADBUTT.d: After a short wind-up the user lunges at a target at short range and drives its head into it, knocking it back.
HEADBUTT.fx: 30% chance to flinch the target for 5 s. The flinch also cancels a cast or beam in progress.

ICEFANG.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and bites it with frozen fangs.
ICEFANG.fx: 10% chance to flinch the target for 5 s and 10% chance to freeze, rolled separately.

ICEPUNCH.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and throws an icy punch.

IRONHEAD.d: After a short wind-up the user lunges at a target at short range and rams it with its steel head, knocking it back.
IRONHEAD.fx: 30% chance to flinch the target for 5 s.

KNOCKOFF.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at short range and swipes once.
KNOCKOFF.fx: 1.5x power if the target holds any item. 60% chance to knock away one of its held items at random for the rest of the battle.

LASTRESORT.d: After a 0.5 s wind-up the user steps in and lands one enormous blow with heavy knockback.
LASTRESORT.fx: Can only be used once every other move the user knows has been cast this match.

LICK.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target and lashes it with its long tongue, which reaches farther than a normal strike.

LIQUIDATION.d: After a short wind-up the user lunges at a target at short range and slams a blade of water into it, knocking it back.
LIQUIDATION.fx: 20% chance to lower the target's Defense one stage for 30 s.

LOWKICK.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and sweeps its legs.
LOWKICK.fx: Power is 20 to 120, higher against bigger, bulkier targets. Light targets (40 power or less) are tripped: rooted for about 0.7 s and their cast is cancelled.

METALCLAW.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and rakes it with a steel claw.
METALCLAW.fx: 30% chance to raise the user's Attack one stage for 30 s.

NIGHTSLASH.d: The user dashes at a target at contact range and makes one fast, dark-edged slash.

PECK.d: The user darts at a target at contact range with one quick beak jab.

PLAYROUGH.d: The user dashes in and brawls with the target at contact range, landing four blows.
PLAYROUGH.fx: Each blow rolls 90% accuracy. 10% chance, once per cast, to lower the target's Attack one stage for 30 s.

POISONJAB.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and stabs it with a poison-tipped jab.

POUND.d: The user darts at a target at contact range and slams it with one forearm blow.
POUND.fx: 0.9 s cooldown, the shortest of any move.

POWERUPPUNCH.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and punches once.
POWERUPPUNCH.fx: Every hit raises the user's Attack one stage for 30 s, stacking up to +6.

REVERSAL.d: The user dashes in and lands three escalating blows at contact range: 20%, 30% and 50% of the damage.
REVERSAL.fx: Power depends on the user's remaining HP: 20 above 70%, rising to 200 below 5%.

SCRATCH.d: The user darts at a target and swipes once, hitting every foe in a small arc in front of it.

SECRETPOWER.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and strikes once.
SECRETPOWER.fx: 30% rider set by the surroundings: grass sleep, water Attack -1, sand Accuracy -1, rock flinch, snow freeze, anywhere else paralysis.

SHADOWCLAW.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and slashes it with a claw of shadow.

SKYATTACK.d: The user glows and charges in place for 3 s, then lunges at a target up to mid range and strikes with huge force.
SKYATTACK.fx: High critical-hit ratio (25% crit chance). 30% chance to flinch the target for 5 s. Taking damage does not cancel the charge.

SLASH.d: The user dashes at a target at contact range and makes one fast diagonal claw slash.

SPARK.d: The user cloaks itself in electricity and dashes straight through the target and out the far side, hitting every foe on the line once.

STRENGTH.d: After a 0.4 s wind-up the user steps in and heaves with both arms, shoving the target far back.

SUPERFANG.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at short range and bites down.
SUPERFANG.fx: Removes half of the target's current HP and can never KO. 70% accuracy.

SUPERPOWER.d: After a 0.5 s wind-up the user steps in and lands one all-out blow with knockback.
SUPERPOWER.fx: After it lands, the user's Attack and Defense each drop one stage for 30 s.

TAKEDOWN.d: After a short wind-up the user charges in a straight, locked line. The first foe it meets takes the hit and the user rebounds.
TAKEDOWN.fx: The user takes 25% of the damage dealt as recoil.

THROATCHOP.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and chops it across the throat.
THROATCHOP.fx: The target can't use sound-based moves for 12 s.

THUNDERFANG.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and bites it with electrified fangs.
THUNDERFANG.fx: 10% chance to flinch the target for 5 s and 10% chance to paralyze, rolled separately.

THUNDERPUNCH.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes at a target at contact range and throws an electrified punch.

WILDCHARGE.d: After a short wind-up the user shrouds itself in electricity and charges in a straight, locked line. The first foe it meets takes the hit and the user rebounds.
WILDCHARGE.fx: The user takes 25% of the damage dealt as recoil.

XSCISSOR.d: The user dashes in and slashes the target twice in an X at contact range, each slash half the damage.

BELLYDRUM.d: The user stands still and drums on its belly for 3 s.
BELLYDRUM.fx: Then it pays 50% of its max HP (never below 1 HP) and raises its Attack six stages for 30 s.

BUBBLEBEAM.d: The user sprays 20 bubbles in a wide fan. They float along their own paths and pop on the first foe they touch or at the arena edge.
BUBBLEBEAM.fx: Each bubble deals 5% damage and has a 15% chance to lower Speed one stage for 30 s.

DARKPULSE.d: The user fires a wave of dark aura at one target at mid range. It hits the first foe it meets.
DARKPULSE.fx: 10% chance to flinch the target for 5 s.

ELECTRICTERRAIN.d: After a 2 s cast, the arena floor crackles with electricity for 30 s. It replaces any other terrain.
ELECTRICTERRAIN.fx: Grounded Pokémon can't fall asleep, and Electric moves used by grounded Pokémon deal 50% more damage.

ENERGYBALL.d: The user fires a large sphere of natural energy at one target at mid range. It hits the first foe it meets.
ENERGYBALL.fx: 5% chance to lower Sp. Def one stage for 30 s.

FIREBLAST.d: The user launches a large, slow fireball at one target at mid range. It hits the first foe it meets.

FLAMETHROWER.d: The user breathes fire in a fixed line at short range for 1.6 s, hitting every foe in its path 10 times.

FOCUSBLAST.d: After a 1 s wind-up, the user lobs two spheres of energy that arc over walls and blast the ground around the target. They can't land right beside the user.
FOCUSBLAST.fx: Each sphere deals 50% damage with 70% accuracy and a 10% chance to lower Sp. Def two stages for 30 s.

GIGADRAIN.d: The user drains the nearest foe within mid range, and green orbs of energy flow back to it.
GIGADRAIN.fx: The user heals 25% of the damage dealt: half at once and half as the orbs arrive.

GRASSYTERRAIN.d: After a 2 s cast, grass covers the arena floor for 30 s. It replaces any other terrain.
GRASSYTERRAIN.fx: Grounded Pokémon heal 1/16 of max HP every 8 s. Grass moves from grounded users deal 50% more. Earthquake, Magnitude and Bulldoze are halved.

GUNKSHOT.d: The user hurls a big bag of filth at one target at mid range. It hits the first foe it meets.

HAIL.d: After a 2 s cast, hail falls over the whole arena for 15 s. It replaces the current weather.
HAIL.fx: Every non-Ice Pokémon, allies included, takes 1/64 of max HP each second.

HYDROPUMP.d: The user fires a high-pressure torrent in a fixed line at long range for 2 s, hitting every foe in its path 10 times.
HYDROPUMP.fx: Each tick pushes the target back along the beam.

HYPERBEAM.d: The user fires an orange beam in a fixed line across most of the arena for 3 s, hitting every foe in its path 20 times.
HYPERBEAM.fx: Deals 1.6x damage. Usable once per match.

ICEBEAM.d: The user fires a thin beam of ice in a fixed line at long range for 1.5 s, hitting every foe in its path 10 times.
ICEBEAM.fx: Each tick has about a 5% chance to freeze.

ICESHARD.d: The user throws a fast shard of ice at one target at short range. After the hit, the shard bounces on to up to two more nearby foes.
ICESHARD.fx: Each bounce deals 55% of the previous hit's damage.

INFERNO.d: A pillar of white fire erupts under the target after a 0.55 s delay, hitting every foe in a small circle. The marker follows the target until just before it erupts.

MISTYTERRAIN.d: After a 2 s cast, a pale mist covers the arena floor for 30 s. It replaces any other terrain.
MISTYTERRAIN.fx: Grounded Pokémon can't be given any status condition, confusion included. Dragon moves deal half damage to grounded targets.

MOONBLAST.d: The user fires a large, slow sphere of moonlight at one target at mid range. It hits the first foe it meets.
MOONBLAST.fx: 30% chance to lower Sp. Atk one stage for 30 s.

PSYCHICTERRAIN.d: After a 2 s cast, the arena floor glows pink for 30 s. It replaces any other terrain.
PSYCHICTERRAIN.fx: Psychic moves from grounded users deal 50% more. Grounded Pokémon can't be hit by bump attacks that skip the cooldown.

RAINDANCE.d: After a 2 s cast, rain falls over the whole arena for 20 s. It replaces the current weather.
RAINDANCE.fx: Water moves deal 50% more damage and Fire moves 50% less. Synthesis heals only 12.5%.

RAZORWIND.d: The user pushes out a wide blade of air that travels across most of the arena, cutting through every foe in its path.

RECOVER.d: The user stands still and glows for a 3 s channel.
RECOVER.fx: Heals 35% of max HP when the channel ends.

SANDSTORM.d: After a 2 s cast, a sandstorm sweeps the whole arena for 15 s. It replaces the current weather.
SANDSTORM.fx: Every Pokémon that isn't Rock, Ground or Steel, allies included, takes 1/64 of max HP each second.

SHADOWBALL.d: The user fires a sphere of shadow at short range that passes through every foe in its path.
SHADOWBALL.fx: 20% chance to lower Sp. Def one stage for 30 s.

SLUDGEBOMB.d: The user lobs a big glob of sludge in a slow arc onto the target. It bursts over an area and leaves a poison pool for 5 s.
SLUDGEBOMB.fx: 7.5% chance to poison each foe in the burst. Foes in the pool take chip damage and have a 25% chance every 0.75 s to be poisoned.

SOLARBEAM.d: After a 0.5 s wind-up, the user fires a colossal beam in a fixed line across most of the arena for 3 s, hitting every foe in its path 30 times.

STEALTHROCK.d: The user scatters 14 pointed stones on the ground around itself. They stay for 20 s.
STEALTHROCK.fx: A foe that steps on them takes damage once, by its Rock weakness: 12.5% of max HP if neutral, up to 50% at 4x, down to 3.125% at 1/4x.

STICKYWEB.d: The user lays 9 strands of web on the ground around itself. They stay for 20 s.
STICKYWEB.fx: A foe that steps on the web loses two Speed stages for 30 s, once per web.

SUNNYDAY.d: After a 2 s cast, harsh sunlight covers the whole arena for 20 s. It replaces the current weather.
SUNNYDAY.fx: Fire moves deal 50% more damage and Water moves 50% less. Synthesis heals 33% instead of 25%.

SWIFT.d: The user fires five golden stars in a cone. Each star homes in on the nearest Pokémon and pops on contact.
SWIFT.fx: Each star deals 20% damage. It never misses.

SWORDSDANCE.d: The user spins in place with two spectral blades for 3 s.
SWORDSDANCE.fx: Raises the user's Attack two stages for 30 s.

TAILWIND.d: After a 1 s cast, a tailwind forms a large circle around the user for 15 s and moves with it.
TAILWIND.fx: The user and allies inside the circle move at double speed.

THUNDERBOLT.d: A lightning bolt strikes the target's spot after a short delay, hitting every foe in a small circle. The marker follows the target until just before it lands.

TOXICSPIKES.d: The user scatters 16 poison caltrops on the ground around itself. They stay for 20 s.
TOXICSPIKES.fx: A foe that steps on them is poisoned, once per set of spikes.

TRIATTACK.d: The user fires a single shot at one target at mid range. It hits the first foe it meets.

BODYSLAM.d: The user leaps at the target and lands flat on it, hitting every foe in a small area. It can't be hit while airborne.
BODYSLAM.fx: 30% chance to paralyze each foe hit.

CIRCLETHROW.d: After a short wind-up the user grabs a foe at contact range, pivots and throws it at an angle all the way to the arena edge.
CIRCLETHROW.fx: The thrown target can't act until it stops sliding, its cast is cancelled and it loses its target lock.

CLOSECOMBAT.d: The user throws 8 punches in a row, about 0.3 s apart, dashing through the target and back for each one. The 120 power is split across them.
CLOSECOMBAT.fx: Once it lands, the user's Defense and Sp. Def each drop one stage for 30 s.

DOUBLESLAP.d: The user hops in and slaps the target 2 to 5 times. Each slap pushes it back a little, so the flurry walks it away.
DOUBLESLAP.fx: 2 or 3 slaps 35% of the time each, 4 or 5 slaps 15% each. Each slap is 15 power with its own 85% accuracy roll.

DRAGONTAIL.d: After a short wind-up the user sweeps its tail into a foe at short range, knocking it straight back to the arena edge.
DRAGONTAIL.fx: The target can't act until it stops sliding, its cast is cancelled and it loses its target lock.

ENCORE.d: The user claps at one target at mid range. It deals no damage and cannot miss.
ENCORE.fx: The target's next 3 casts are forced to be the move it used last. Protect and Substitute block it.

FAKEOUT.d: The user surges in at short range, claps in the target's face for chip damage, then snaps back to where it started.
FAKEOUT.fx: Flinches the target for 5 s, cancels its cast and adds 2 s to its cooldown. Only usable in the first 15 s after entering or Mega Evolving.

HEAVYSLAM.d: The user leaps and drops its full weight onto the target, hitting every foe in a small area. It can't be hit while airborne.
HEAVYSLAM.fx: Power is 40 to 120, higher the bigger and bulkier the user is compared to each target.

HIGHJUMPKICK.d: The user leaps very high and drives a knee down onto one target. It can't be hit while airborne.
HIGHJUMPKICK.fx: If it hits nothing, the user takes 50% of its max HP as crash damage and is stunned for 0.75 s.

JUMPKICK.d: The user makes a quick, flat leap and kicks down onto one target. It can't be hit while airborne.
JUMPKICK.fx: If it hits nothing, the user takes 25% of its max HP as crash damage and is stunned for 0.33 s.

MEGAKICK.d: After a 0.8 s wind-up the user swings one enormous kick at a foe at contact range, launching it far back.
MEGAKICK.fx: The target tumbles and can't act for 0.5 s.

MEGAPUNCH.d: After a quicker wind-up than Mega Kick, the user throws one huge straight punch at a foe at contact range, knocking it back.
MEGAPUNCH.fx: The target tumbles and can't act for 0.2 s.

ROAR.d: After a short wind-up the user roars across a wide cone in front of it at mid range. It deals no damage.
ROAR.fx: Every foe in the cone is shoved to the arena edge, can't act while sliding and loses its target lock. Protect blocks it.

STOMP.d: The user hops at a target and stamps down, hitting every foe in a small area. It can't be hit while airborne.
STOMP.fx: 30% chance to flinch each foe hit for 5 s.

STOMPINGTANTRUM.d: The user jumps at a target and stomps down with both feet, hitting every foe in a small area. It can't be hit while airborne.
STOMPINGTANTRUM.fx: Double damage and a 1.5x larger blast if the user's previous attack failed to land.

WHIRLWIND.d: After a short wind-up the user blows a gust into a cone in front of it at mid range. It deals no damage.
WHIRLWIND.fx: The farthest foe in the cone is blown to the arena edge and loses its target lock. The twister stays 4 s and throws any foe that walks into it.

DOUBLETEAM.d: After a short wind-up the user splits into 3 copies that burst apart and walk around the arena on their own for 12 s.
DOUBLETEAM.fx: Foes often aim at a copy instead of the user, and any hit on a copy pops it. +1 Evasion while any copy is left.

REFLECT.d: After a 1 s cast a blue screen settles over the user's side for 12 s.
REFLECT.fx: Halves physical damage to everyone on the user's side. In a free-for-all it covers only the user.

ENDURE.d: The user braces itself for 4 s.
ENDURE.fx: No damage can take it below 1 HP while it braces. Can't be used again for 15 s.

SNATCH.d: The user lies in wait for 5 s.
SNATCH.fx: The next heal, buff, screen or ward any foe casts is stolen and applied to the user instead.

MAGICCOAT.d: The user raises a reflective coat for 20 s.
MAGICCOAT.fx: Any status move aimed at it is bounced straight back at the caster.

SAFEGUARD.d: After a 1 s cast a green dome settles over the user's side for 20 s.
SAFEGUARD.fx: No new status condition can be applied to anyone it covers. It doesn't cure what is already there.

TRICKROOM.d: After a 1.5 s cast a warped room forms around the user, a big zone that stays where it was cast for 20 s.
TRICKROOM.fx: Foes inside it move with their Speed inverted: the slowest move fastest. Casting it again ends it.

WATERSPORT.d: After a short cast the user soaks a big zone of the floor around it for 20 s.
WATERSPORT.fx: Fire moves hitting or cast from inside the zone deal half damage.

PSYCHUP.d: The user focuses on the nearest foe and copies it.
PSYCHUP.fx: The user's stat stages become exactly the target's, boosts and drops alike.

CHARGE.d: The user roots itself and charges up for 2 s.
CHARGE.fx: +1 Sp. Def, and its next Electric attack deals double damage.

MAGNETRISE.d: The user rises off the ground on magnetic force and floats for 15 s.
MAGNETRISE.fx: Immune to Ground moves, Spikes and every ground hazard and terrain while it floats.

ROOST.d: The user lands and rests for 5 s, rooted in place.
ROOST.fx: Heals 25% of its max HP over the rest. It loses its Flying type while roosting.

ROCKPOLISH.d: The user polishes its body for 2 s, rooted in place.

CALMMIND.d: The user meditates for 3 s, rooted in place.

HARDEN.fx: +1 Defense, and for 6 s it can't be knocked back, pulled or dragged.

AGILITY.d: The user's body blurs and it leaves a speed trail for 20 s.

BULKUP.d: The user flexes for 3 s, rooted in place.

CURSE.d: A Ghost-type user pays half its max HP to curse a foe at mid range. Any other user slows down to bulk up.
CURSE.fx: Ghost: the target loses 1/4 of its max HP every 8 s until one of them faints. Anyone else: +1 Attack, +1 Defense, -1 Speed.

DREAMEATER.d: The user feeds on a sleeping foe's dreams at mid range over about 2 s.
DREAMEATER.fx: Heals the user 50% of the damage dealt. Fails against a foe that is awake.

TRICK.d: The user swaps held items with a foe at mid range before it notices.
TRICK.fx: Swaps the user's full set of items, up to as many as the target holds. Fails if the user holds nothing.

SKILLSWAP.d: The user trades Abilities with a foe at mid range.
SKILLSWAP.fx: Each takes the other's Ability, and what the old one did comes off.

CHARM.d: The user acts adorably in a narrow cone in front of it at mid range.
CHARM.fx: Every foe in the cone: Attack -2.

GROWL.d: A sound wave rolls out in a wide cone in front of the user at short range.
GROWL.fx: Every foe in the cone: Attack -1.

LEER.d: The user glares in a narrow cone in front of it.
LEER.fx: Every foe in the cone: Defense -1.

SANDATTACK.d: The user kicks sand in a narrow cone in front of it. It deals no damage.
SANDATTACK.fx: Every foe in the cone: Accuracy -1.

DEFOG.d: A strong gust blows through a cone in front of the user.
DEFOG.fx: Clears every hazard, seed bed, screen, mist and cloud on the whole arena, both sides. Foes in the cone: Evasion -1.

BRINE.d: After a short wind-up the user sends a wave of salt water rolling forward, fanning out over mid range.
BRINE.fx: Double damage against a target under 50% HP.

TORMENT.d: The user torments a foe at mid range for 20 s. It deals no damage.
TORMENT.fx: The target can't use the same move twice in a row.

TELEKINESIS.d: The user lifts a foe off the ground with its mind, holding it still for 1.5 s, then leaving it floating for 15 s.
TELEKINESIS.fx: Nothing can miss it while it floats, but it is immune to Ground moves.

DISCHARGE.d: After a short crackling wind-up, arcs of electricity jump from the user to every Pokémon at short range, allies included.

STONEEDGE.d: Cracks open under a foe's spot at long range, then jagged stone pillars erupt there.

FLASHCANNON.d: After a short charge the user fires a focused beam of light at a foe at mid range.
FLASHCANNON.fx: 10% chance to lower Sp. Def one stage.

EMBER.d: The user lobs a small flame a short distance; it pops into a flare where it lands.
EMBER.fx: 10% chance to burn. 1 s cooldown, the shortest of any Fire move.

PSYSHOCK.d: The user fires a bolt of psychic crystal at a foe at mid range.
PSYSHOCK.fx: A special attack that hits the target's Defense, not its Sp. Def.

SMACKDOWN.d: The user throws a rock at a foe at mid range.
SMACKDOWN.fx: Knocks a Pokémon mid-Fly out of the sky. Grounds any floating target for the rest of the match, so Ground moves reach it.

LEECHSEED.d: The user flings seeds that plant a patch of seedlings on the field for 20 s, like Toxic Spikes.
LEECHSEED.fx: A foe that steps on a seed is seeded: it loses 1/16 of its max HP every 3 s for 25 s, and the user heals that much. Grass types are immune.

RAZORLEAF.d: After a short wind-up the user fires a fan of 5 sharp leaves at short range.

MUDSLAP.d: The user flings a clump of mud at a foe at mid range.
MUDSLAP.fx: Always lowers the target's Accuracy one stage.

POISONSTING.d: The user fires a single poison barb at a foe at mid range.
POISONSTING.fx: 30% chance to poison. 0.9 s cooldown, the shortest of any Poison move.

NIGHTSHADE.d: A shadow drops over a foe at mid range after a moment.
NIGHTSHADE.fx: Always deals exactly 40 damage, whatever either side's stats.

ELECTROBALL.d: The user hurls a ball of electricity at a foe at mid range.
ELECTROBALL.fx: Power grows with how much faster the user is: 40 if slower, up to 150 at 4 times the target's Speed.

VOLTSWITCH.d: The user zaps a foe at mid range with a bolt, then is flung to the far edge of the arena.
VOLTSWITCH.fx: Every foe targeting the user loses track of it.

UTURN.d: After a short wind-up the user dashes in and strikes a foe at short range, then is flung to the far edge of the arena.
UTURN.fx: Every foe targeting the user loses track of it.

FLY.d: The user takes off and can't be targeted for 2 s high in the sky, then dives onto a foe at mid range.
FLY.fx: 95% accuracy. Smack Down can knock it out of the sky.

DIG.d: The user burrows underground for 2 s, where it can't be targeted, then erupts beneath a foe.
DIG.fx: Earthquake still reaches it underground, for double damage.

ACROBATICS.d: After a short wind-up the user flips in, strikes a foe at short range, and flips back out.
ACROBATICS.fx: Double power if the user holds no item at all.

QUICKATTACK.d: The user dashes in with no wind-up, strikes a foe at short range, and backs off.

SUCKERPUNCH.d: When a foe starts an attack at the user, the user dashes in and punches it first. It is never used any other way.
SUCKERPUNCH.fx: Then waits out its own cooldown before it can react again.

ALLYSWITCH.d: The user instantly swaps places with its nearest ally. In a free-for-all, with the nearest other Pokémon.
ALLYSWITCH.fx: Projectiles homing on either of them now home on the other.

LEECHLIFE.d: After a short wind-up the user latches onto a foe at short range and bites 3 times.
LEECHLIFE.fx: Heals the user 50% of the damage dealt.
